subject: MENTAL HEALT
bill.title: Authorizes provision of residential mental health services in residential substance use disorders treatment facility or program under specified hospital affiliation and clinical support criteria.

action.description: 2nd Reading on Concur with Governor's Recommendations (38-0)

posted_text:
🏥 NJ S4477 — NJ Could Expand Mental Health Care for Substance Users

New Jersey is considering a change that would allow licensed substance use disorder facilities to offer residential mental health treatment services.

This would happen if the facility has a formal agreement with a hospital that provides psychiatric care.

The bill aims to improve care for people with co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders, who often need treatment between traditional inpatient care and outpatient services.

The agreement would need to include things like shared clinical policies, 24/7 consultation, and plans for transferring patients to inpatient care if needed.

Facilities would have to share their contract with the Department of Health.

Oct. 22, 2026: 2nd Reading on Concur with Governor's Recommendations (38-0).

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/S4477
